description.narrative: "Crown the Woman-South Sudan is young women led and founded grassroots national organization that aims at empowering girls and women socially, politically and economically. CTW-SS works to promote peace and bridge the inequality gap between women and men in South Sudan - a war and conflict-torn area where young women experience extreme levels of systemic and individual violence. Crown the Woman aims to recognize, develop the potential and promote the strength of young women's leadership across communities socially, economically, and politically for a sustainable and equitable growth. The Equality Fund grant will support Crown the Woman's core operational mission costs such as salaries and transport, including the following activities: -Capacity building -Strengthening the organisation's financial systems by purchasing QuickBooks and training the finance officer on how to use it. - Training of staff and volunteers on financial reporting and proposal development."
